Name: Arachnophobia - Cute Seals instead of Spiders
Author: pipisi81
Description:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces the spider monster from the challenging mine with a cute pixel seal.[/*]
[*]Completely transforms the remains of spiders (death particles) into splashes of water.[/*]
[*]Replaces the creepy spiders from the maze of the formal festival (the eve of the Day of the Spirits) and preserves/replaces the web for your maximum comfort.[/*]
[/list] [b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][b] After all:[/b]
 Umm this is actually my first experience in creating mods. Initially, I only did this for my girlfriend, because she anyway was afraid of this paw-less mod. I thought it might scare someone, so I decided to post it here if someone needs it
